verses.original: רַנְּנ֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה לַ֝יְשָׁרִ֗ים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ran·nə·nū ṣad·dî·qîm Yah·weh lay·šā·rîm nā·wāh ṯə·hil·lāh
verses.literal: Rejoice in the LORD O righteous ones it is fitting for the upright to praise Him
verses.literalPt: Exultai, ó justos, em Jeová; aos retos fica bem o louvor.

verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּנֵ֥בֶל עָ֝שׂ֗וֹר זַמְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh bə·ḵin·nō·wr bə·nê·ḇel ‘ā·śō·wr zam·mə·rū- lōw
verses.literal: Praise the LORD with the harp make music to Him with ten strings . . .
verses.literalPt: Dai graças a Jeová com a harpa, cantai-lhe louvores com o saltério de dez cordas.

verses.original: שִֽׁירוּ־ ל֭וֹ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ הֵיטִ֥יבוּ נַ֝גֵּ֗ן בִּתְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šî·rū- lōw šîr ḥā·ḏāš hê·ṭî·ḇū nag·gên biṯ·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: Sing to Him a new song play skillfully with a shout of joy
verses.literalPt: Entoai-lhe um cântico novo, tocai bem e com júbilo.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָשָׁ֥ר דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־ מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗הוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·šār də·ḇar- Yah·weh wə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śê·hū be·’ĕ·mū·nāh
verses.literal: For the word of the LORD is upright and all His work is trustworthy
verses.literalPt: Pois reta é a palavra de Jeová; e tudo quanto faz é com fidelidade.

verses.original: אֹ֭הֵב צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט חֶ֥סֶד יְ֝הוָ֗ה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·miš·pāṭ ḥe·seḏ Yah·weh mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD loves righteousness and justice the earth is full of His loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Ele ama a retidão e a justiça; a terra está cheia da benignidade de Jeová.

verses.original: בִּדְבַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה שָׁמַ֣יִם נַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּבְר֥וּחַ פִּ֝֗יו כָּל־ צְבָאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh šā·ma·yim na·‘ă·śū ū·ḇə·rū·aḥ pîw kāl- ṣə·ḇā·’ām
verses.literal: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made and all the stars by the breath of His mouth
verses.literalPt: Pela palavra de Jeová, foram feitos os céus; e, pelo sopro da sua boca todo o exército deles.

verses.original: כֹּנֵ֣ס כַּ֭נֵּד מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם נֹתֵ֖ן בְּאֹצָר֣וֹת תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kō·nês kan·nêḏ mê hay·yām nō·ṯên bə·’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ tə·hō·w·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: He piles up . . . the waters of the sea He puts the depths into storehouses
verses.literalPt: Ele ajunta, qual uma mole, as águas do mar; amontoa em tesouros os abismos.

verses.original: יִֽירְא֣וּ מֵ֭יְהוָה כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ יָ֝ג֗וּרוּ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yî·rə·’ū Yah·weh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ mim·men·nū yā·ḡū·rū kāl- yō·šə·ḇê ṯê·ḇêl
verses.literal: Let all the earth fear . . . the LORD let all the people of the world revere Him
verses.literalPt: Tema a Jeová toda a terra, tenham medo dele todos os habitantes do mundo.

verses.original: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר וַיֶּ֑הִי הֽוּא־ צִ֝וָּ֗ה וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî hū ’ā·mar way·ye·hî hū- ṣiw·wāh way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: For He spoke and it came to be He commanded and it stood firm
verses.literalPt: Pois ele falou e foi feito; ele ordenou, e ficou estabelecido.

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵפִ֥יר עֲצַת־ גּוֹיִ֑ם הֵ֝נִ֗יא מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hê·p̄îr ‘ă·ṣaṯ- gō·w·yim hê·nî maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations He thwarts the devices of the peoples
verses.literalPt: Jeová reduz a nada o conselho das nações; anula os intentos dos povos.

verses.original: עֲצַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תַּעֲמֹ֑ד מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת לִ֝בּ֗וֹ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṣaṯ Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām ta·‘ă·mōḏ maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ lib·bōw lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: The counsel of the LORD stands forever . . . the purposes of His heart to all generations . . .
verses.literalPt: O conselho de Jeová persiste para sempre; os intentos do seu coração, por todas as gerações.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הַ֭גּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו הָעָ֓ם׀ בָּחַ֖ר לְנַחֲלָ֣ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê hag·gō·w ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw hā·‘ām bā·ḥar lə·na·ḥă·lāh lōw
verses.literal: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD the people He has chosen as His inheritance
verses.literalPt: Feliz é a nação que tem por Deus a Jeová, o povo que ele escolheu para a sua herança.

verses.original: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִבִּ֣יט יְהוָ֑ה רָ֝אָ֗ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miš·šā·ma·yim hib·bîṭ Yah·weh rā·’āh ’eṯ- kāl- bə·nê hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: The LORD looks down from heaven He sees all the sons of men
verses.literalPt: Jeová olha lá do céu, vê todos os filhos dos homens;

verses.original: מִֽמְּכוֹן־ שִׁבְתּ֥וֹ הִשְׁגִּ֑יחַ אֶ֖ל כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mim·mə·ḵō·wn- šiḇ·tōw hiš·gî·aḥ ’el kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth
verses.literalPt: lá do lugar da sua habitação, dirige o seu olhar para todos os habitantes da terra,

verses.original: הַיֹּצֵ֣ר יַ֣חַד לִבָּ֑ם הַ֝מֵּבִ֗ין אֶל־ כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·ṣêr ya·ḥaḏ lib·bām ham·mê·ḇîn ’el- kāl- ma·‘ă·śê·hem
verses.literal: He shapes the hearts of each He considers . . . all their works
verses.literalPt: aquele que forma o coração de todos eles, que considera todas as suas obras.

verses.original: אֵֽין־ הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁ֣ע בְּרָב־ חָ֑יִל גִּ֝בּ֗וֹר לֹֽא־ יִנָּצֵ֥ל בְּרָב־ כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- ham·me·leḵ nō·wō·šā‘ bə·rāḇ- ḥā·yil gib·bō·wr lō- yin·nā·ṣêl bə·rāḇ- kō·aḥ
verses.literal: No king is saved by his vast army no warrior is delivered by his great strength
verses.literalPt: Não há rei que se salve com grande exército, nem por grande força se livra um poderoso.

verses.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭סּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָ֑ה וּבְרֹ֥ב חֵ֝יל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: še·qer has·sūs liṯ·šū·‘āh ū·ḇə·rōḇ ḥê·lōw lō yə·mal·lêṭ
verses.literal: A horse is a vain hope for salvation even its great strength cannot save
verses.literalPt: Falaz é o cavalo para a segurança, e, pela sua grande força, a ninguém pode livrar.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה עֵ֣ין יְ֭הוָה אֶל־ יְרֵאָ֑יו לַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘ên Yah·weh ’el- yə·rê·’āw lam·ya·ḥă·lîm lə·ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Eis que os olhos de Jeová estão sobre os que o temem, sobre os que esperam na sua benignidade,

verses.original: לְהַצִּ֣יל מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וּ֝לְחַיּוֹתָ֗ם בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haṣ·ṣîl mim·mā·weṯ nap̄·šām ū·lə·ḥay·yō·w·ṯām bā·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine
verses.literalPt: para livrar da morte as suas almas e conservar-lhes a vida em tempo de fome.

verses.original: נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה עֶזְרֵ֖נוּ וּמָגִנֵּ֣נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šê·nū ḥik·kə·ṯāh Yah·weh ‘ez·rê·nū ū·mā·ḡin·nê·nū hū
verses.literal: Our soul waits for the LORD He is our help and our shield
verses.literalPt: A nossa alma espera por Jeová. Ele é o nosso auxílio e o nosso escudo.

verses.original: כִּי־ ב֭וֹ יִשְׂמַ֣ח לִבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י בְשֵׁ֖ם קָדְשׁ֣וֹ בָטָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇōw yiś·maḥ lib·bê·nū kî ḇə·šêm qā·ḏə·šōw ḇā·ṭā·ḥə·nū
verses.literal: For our hearts rejoice in Him since we trust in His holy name
verses.literalPt: Pois o nosso coração nele se alegrará, porque, no seu santo nome, temos confiado.

verses.original: יְהִֽי־ חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עָלֵ֑ינוּ כַּ֝אֲשֶׁ֗ר יִחַ֥לְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî- ḥas·də·ḵā Yah·weh ‘ā·lê·nū ka·’ă·šer yi·ḥal·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: May Your loving devotion rest on us O LORD as we put our hope in You
verses.literalPt: Seja sobre nós, Jeová, a tua benignidade, assim como temos esperado em ti.
